an6.48:1.1: 48 atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi

an6.48:1.3: sandiṭṭhiko dhammo sandiṭṭhiko dhammoti bho gotama vuccati
an6.48:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bho gotama sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti
